body:
Source: repo-bloat review (rev-tests finding 1 & 2, issue #1043). Four test files in packages/autopilot/test manually invoke mkdtempSync and guard removals in try/finally blocks, and are allowlisted in scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs. With @adlc/core/test-kit (tmp), fixture directories automatically register cleanup via t.after when passed the test context t, and safely clean up in standalone runs.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. In packages/autopilot/test/init.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update tests to accept t parameter and replace scratch() with tmp(t, 'ap-init-').
   - Remove manual try/finally cleanup blocks.
   - Delete the local const scratch = ... helper.
2. In packages/autopilot/test/input.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update test using temp directory to accept t parameter and replace mkdtempSync on line 66 with tmp(t, 'ap-input-').
3. In packages/autopilot/test/lock.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update tests to accept t parameter and replace scratch = () => ... and mkdtempSync calls with tmp(t, 'ap-lock-').
   - Remove manual try/finally cleanup blocks.
   - Delete the local const scratch = ... helper.
4. In packages/autopilot/test/loop.test.mjs:
   - Import { tmp } from '@adlc/core/test-kit'.
   - Update mkdtempSync calls on lines 186, 196, 203, 208, 252 with tmp(null, prefix) or tmp(t, prefix).
5. In scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs:
   - Remove packages/autopilot/test/init.test.mjs, packages/autopilot/test/input.test.mjs, packages/autopilot/test/lock.test.mjs, and packages/autopilot/test/loop.test.mjs from ALLOWLIST.
6. Verification:
   - npm test -w packages/autopilot exits 0 with all tests passing.
   - node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 packages/autopilot/test/init.test.mjs does not define scratch.
- AC2 packages/autopilot/test/lock.test.mjs does not define scratch.
- AC3 None of the 4 test files appear in scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs ALLOWLIST.
- AC4 npm test -w packages/autopilot exits 0 with all tests passing.
- AC5 node --test scripts/test/tmp-fixture-boundary.test.mjs exits 0.
- AC6 adlc rails-guard exits 0.
title: refactor(autopilot): adopt @adlc/core/test-kit in init, input, lock, and loop tests
